goal: Prove that a scheduled ChatGPT Work invocation can read Panoptes, make one bounded GitHub change on an isolated branch, persist an execution receipt, and leave enough durable state for the next heartbeat.
rules: Never mutate main from the canary.
A task status message is not evidence; success requires a verified GitHub commit on the sandbox branch.
Do not use Interception, GEPA reflection, Archotraz, ARTTOO, or another project for the canary.
Do not infer account availability from an ordinary Work failure.
Persist the exact panoptes.execution-result/v1 receipt under .panoptes/results/<prompt_id>.json when executing a Panoptes-generated prompt.

units.objective: Create one durable scheduled-Work canary receipt on the isolated Panoptes sandbox and verify it by re-reading GitHub.
acceptance_criteria: A new commit exists on sandbox/work-canary-20260928 and main is unchanged.
The commit adds a canary evidence JSON containing execution timestamp, source main SHA, sandbox pre-run SHA, and scheduled_work_canary=passed.
The Work invocation re-reads the sandbox branch and verifies the new commit SHA before reporting success.
exclusions: Do not merge, deploy, publish, or touch another repository.
Do not call Interception or perform model-comparison work.

units.objective: Prove that the next Work heartbeat can discover the prior durable receipt and produce a distinct bounded continuation without redoing the canary write.
acceptance_criteria: The prior canary evidence is discovered from durable repository state.
The prior canary unit is not re-executed.
A distinct continuation artifact or receipt is committed on the sandbox branch with causal reference to the prior canary commit.
exclusions: Do not broaden into another project.
